title: P2 seat.vacate: request
description: Body of P2 seat.vacate. An operator operation, only through farmctl, with admin:governance in the tenant of the seat (PRM-14): the seat becomes vacant, epoch + 1, the previous holder retires with the trigger replaced_by_human, and for the farm manager seat with the reason incident, with the trigger replaced_after_incident (IDN-11).

seat.description: Seat id: farm-manager (the farm manager seat, tenant farm) or commission:<seat number from the tenant charter>.
